# Independent review of A2 anti-driver binding

Reviewed frozen `7ee13683976e27dce351294bb444b1f38e490a3e`, native candidate
`2bef891f05af1eefc1c00db238a90bb544c9dc8d`, B0 native reference
`c3ff1d73398b46cc7019465f78fc44f7e598670a` and common
`773f7746466caf0ba4eff70a741e9594d07f39cc`. Source-only review: the reviewer
ran no engines, builds, tests or large fixture hashes.

No unresolved blocker was found to the authorized original one/sixteen-client
timing. This is not a mixed-performance result or promotion decision.

`adapter/anti-driver-candidate-binding.mjs:14–34` fixes the source commits,
B0 f44/55/af and A2 000def/593/c886 artifact sets, qualified manifest hashes
and build-option fields. Actual inspection resolves SDK -> bindings ->
platform engine, hashes the selected bytes and verifies owner/core/engine
pairing (`:45–68`). Admission preserves original e992 budget bytes, complete
baseline identities, approved source fingerprint and v1 adapter754. It
allows only the anti-header source difference, with unchanged build/catalog,
owner and SDK metadata (`:71–97`). The fe9 native attestor additionally
checks declared native/build/vendor inputs against Git; helper/harness/build
sources are pinned before and after (`:100–115`). The fe9 B helper remains
unchanged. Candidate/common_control are artifact roles, not app modes.

The shared runner diff adds artifact admission and role recording, with the
same source/recipe preflight and drift checks. Its query, readCell/write
loops, correction oracle, original one/sixteen configuration and numerical
gate function are unchanged. Source checksum and closed-file identity still
bookend fresh owned clones. Six new pure policy cases plus the original
nine are scoped to binding/default admission, not live-owner proof.

The native transformation is relationally sound: materialize admitted input
A, select valid positive rows P using the original constants and repeated
variable equalities, then form D' as denied rows in A that satisfy the exact
typed membership equation with some P row. P ANTI D' equals P ANTI A.
SEMI does not multiply denied rows. Full logical input admission remains
before the subset reduction (`native/src/temporal_anti_join_plan.hpp:21–70`);
computed/aggregate and unsupported profiles retain the prior route. This
review does not replace the separate six-method/four-plan execution gate.

A broad-positive/tiny-denied shape can pay for an extra materialization and
SEMI pass, so the planned 32768-positive regression control remains relevant
before any universal optimization claim. In that separate source-only
control, the field called SDK hashes the adapter module, and engine identity
is copied from the manifest. Rename the former and use actual engine/SDK or
qualified binding plus drift checks before presenting that standalone output
as comparative evidence. This does not affect the main cleared A2 binding.
Fresh/reverse comparisons and broader regression gates remain pending.
